title: Bound every G20 catalogue contact expansion below BIT saving 0.0037
body:
For every catalogue frame and **every subset of 17,060 movable contacts**, the frozen G20 word can save at most **0.002862 local paid moment** at BIT saving 0.0037. All 18 calls may choose their own frame and subset. The complete caller moment remains at most **-46.255824**, even with free nonrecursive work. A separate invoice argument excludes every higher working exponent through 1. No new kappa is claimed.

[Scope](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bf17817bcaae61379dcadd50ee6bde9a6c7f5018/research/bit-g20-contact-expansion-bound/README.md), [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bf17817bcaae61379dcadd50ee6bde9a6c7f5018/research/bit-g20-contact-expansion-bound/PROOF.md), [exact checks](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bf17817bcaae61379dcadd50ee6bde9a6c7f5018/research/bit-g20-contact-expansion-bound/verify.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bf17817bcaae61379dcadd50ee6bde9a6c7f5018/research/bit-g20-contact-expansion-bound/SOURCES.json), [registered replay](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bf17817bcaae61379dcadd50ee6bde9a6c7f5018/research/bit-g20-contact-expansion-bound/VERIFY.json). Base: canonical main `5e0052ca0aa3036a3afa8b0438927377c8d97d53`, priority revision 7. Contribution head: `bf17817bcaae61379dcadd50ee6bde9a6c7f5018`.

This covers all 645 rational projector frames and every finite proper nested public-query path through the catalogue. It permits simultaneous changes across different original contact blocks while preserving scalar order, owned instructions, helper targets and original boundaries. Exact physical frame spaces, 26,312 nested edges and 37,299 field intervals are bound to PR5512 at main 5e0052ca0aa3036a3afa8b0438927377c8d97d53. Submission refreshed canonical main to 6cf7a683f447b9f1e2333791907fd92be5009a63; AGENTS, procedure, priorities, selected record and family guidance are unchanged. Coordination: [Discussion5610](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5610).

Registered Python 3.12 normal and optimized checks pass. The standard-library replay checks all 10,361,748 positive flow entries for exact capacity and conservation, every catalogue label, integer-power tariff intervals, complete RAW/DIRTY scalar endpoints and a corrupt-flow control. Feasible flows prove the bound without trusting optimality or a solver. SciPy 1.15.3 supplied the first checked search; OR-Tools 9.14.6206 independently exported the certificate. Neither is required for registered replay. The decoded flow certificate SHA256 is 6eb404236d11729710b37bc77c3585ada3798563f8fe7607b484c54d65e08ec0.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-g20-contact-expansion-bound
```

Python 3.12 and the standard library suffice. Committed-byte checks pass. This is a source-bound one-new-frame expansion class, not a global contact optimum. New projectors, several new labels in one move, neutral-move sequences, changed scalar order, address-dependent recoding, owned contacts and targets remain open. The native frame induction and caller wiring are credited premises. The full physical caller/compiler/precision/outer proof, formal kernel, Git-free export and full historical ancestry were not rerun. The binary certificate is about 29 MB compressed. Hosted status is unconfirmed at publication.

Credit ai-nanachi PR5512/G20 and compact436; Dugongue PR5586 B2; Ali Romman PR5421; DreamingOfClouds, eumemic, Cinna Davis / 1337isnot1337, rohanarun, zxv, Jacob Alan Sussman and all retained native/cover/compiler authors. The P104 event-retiming work motivates the contact test. Graph cuts and feasible-flow lower bounds are classical methods.

Next: supply a changed word outside the catalogue expansion class, then replay its exact endpoint and complete bill. The selected frontier is unchanged.

Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
